executionResultPolicy.actualResults: All actualResult null until product actually executes; independently calculated golden hashes and numerical expected values are authoring inputs only.

conventions.fixtureTransformation: All JSON Pointer paths address complete Document. Exactly apply replacements; every unmentioned field preserved; non-base fixture IDs listed inline are authoritative. Sources are read-only. Fixture paths describe planned materialization, not files claimed written by this author.
conventions.reset: Every branch/subcase starts from a fresh source fixture and isolated Node verification session unless a sequence explicitly states otherwise. Input segments consume consecutive ticks starting tick1; tick0 is creation and costs no time.
conventions.input: x/y are raw -1|0|1 vectors; Runtime normalizes nonzero direction then speed160/60. InputSource only human_keyboard|machine_browser_input|catalog_machine. ExecutionClass per atomic result automation_test|human_operation. Mixed parent cases split records, never assign a fake source.
conventions.identifiers: Normal requestId/commandId are actual UUIDs from host. Fixture project IDs may be controlled ASCII. symbolic candidate ops in prose use the exact op/expectedValue/value DTO in runtime contract; do not serialize prose abbreviations.
conventions.exactness: Boolean contact/chase/terminal/order/count assertions are exact. Rational/square-root authoring expectations below are exact mathematical values; independent numeric report must state any error tolerance before actual evaluation. Such tolerance never changes Runtime <=threshold.
conventions.evidenceRoot: evidence/r0/<build-id>/; all real runs 04_runs/<runId>/; case/request indexes reference runs without creating parallel case execution roots.
conventions.human: Human action/choice and semantic judgment cannot be filled by agent roleplay. Automation typing is machine_browser_input/automation_test. Actual operator/reviewer must be registered by root.
conventions.blocked: Missing environment/executor/approval/human branch leaves that branch blocked; CLI work can proceed where authorized, never promote whole case from a partial branch.
